Step 3. Consider the skew-symmetric operator \(A_{01330013}\) acting on the topological space. By the skew-symmetric decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|A_{01330013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01330013\).

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through rational approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
